description: Defines thread-local storage management and thread private data structures for Windows platform in the Starboard shared library.

classes.name: ThreadSubsystemSingleton
classes.description: Singleton managing thread-local keys and thread private data for Windows.

classes.name: SbThreadPrivate
classes.description: Represents private thread data, including synchronization primitives and thread handle.

classes.name: ThreadCreateInfo
classes.description: Holds information needed to create a thread, including entry point and context.

methods.name: SbThreadIsValidLocalKey
methods.description: Checks if a thread-local key is valid.

methods.name: GetThreadSubsystemSingleton
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance managing thread subsystem.

methods.name: RegisterMainThread
methods.description: Registers the main thread with the thread subsystem.

methods.name: GetCurrentSbThreadPrivate
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's private data structure.
